name: Storm of Vengeance

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A 300-foot-radius storm: Con save or 2d6 Thunder and Deafened, then acid, lightning, hail and freezing rain on your later turns.
text: At the start of your later turns: turn 2, 4d6 Acid to everything under the cloud; turn 3, six bolts on six targets (Dex save, 10d6 Lightning, half on a success); turn 4, 2d6 Bludgeoning to each creature; turns 5-10, 1d6 Cold to each creature. From turn 5 the area is also Difficult Terrain and Heavily Obscured, ranged weapon attacks there are impossible, and strong wind blows.
